source.basis: Operator facility page; structured facts only, no operator prose reproduced.

reading.body:
QTS Sacramento publishes 4 MW of IT capacity across two addresses on the same campus. At 40 kW per rack, a common AI training density, 4 MW of IT load is roughly 100 racks, and at 10 kW per rack, a common colocation density, it is roughly 400 racks. No certifications are listed in the published specifications, so no qualification statements can be made. Tenant information is not published.

Among the five California facilities this site has read capacity figures for, QTS Sacramento ranks fourth, contributing 4 MW of the 170 MW total those five facilities publish, or about 2.4 percent. This site has mapped 103 facilities in California, and 98 of them publish no megawatt figure, so the 170 MW total understates actual California capacity by an unknown amount.

For a reader deciding whether this campus matters to AI, the published scale is modest. One hundred racks at AI training densities supports a real but limited workload, not a large-scale training cluster. The campus may serve inference, enterprise AI, or mixed colocation demand, but the published data does not specify use cases. Compute at this scale is downstream of 4 MW of power, and whether that power can grow is not addressed in the operator's published specifications.
